text:
sarah: Heads-up: scheduling a pen-test dry-run Tue 2026-04-02. Goal: validate temporary RBAC, KMS proxy access, and audit export stream for evidence collection. Asking owners to confirm ephemeral roles, S3 evidence path, and retest cadence.

mike: I can own RBAC changes and rollback playbook. Plan: create time-limited RoleBinding in `pt-window` namespace with expiry annotation and PR for automation.

oliver: I'll stand up the KMS proxy and restrict SG to assessor IPs. Need the KMS key ARN and allowed ops = Encrypt,Decrypt,GenerateDataKey.

emma: We'll generate presigned URLs for evidence uploads to `s3://redwood-pt-evidence/1764992022/`. Bucket policy: block public ACLs, log PutObject events to CloudTrail. Lifecycle: transition to GLACIER after 30d, delete after 90d.

qa: Evidence checklist: capture PoC, request/response, stack traces, and attach remediation ticket ID. We'll tag tickets `pt:high` or `pt:medium`. Also note: rotate presigns every 12h and record generation events.

provision-bot: Created S3 path `s3://redwood-pt-evidence/1764992022/` and calendar event "pt-dryrun-04-02" for 2026-04-02 17:00 PST.

sarah: CloudTrail: export events for `GenerateDataKey`, `Decrypt`, `AssumeRole` and k8s-audit to the evidence prefix. Disable log scrubbing in the window.

mike: Rollback snippets added to runbook: `helm rollback my-app 2` and `kubectl apply -f configmap-prod-rollback.yaml`.

oliver: I'll post AMI + SG IDs in #eng-infra and link here.

emma: QA will upload `evidence_manifest.json` template to the S3 path.

sarah: Owners: oliver (KMS + ephemeral roles), mike (RBAC + rollback), emma (audit export + bucket policy), qa (packaging + triage), sarah (PT owner & retest scheduling). Reconvene Mon 04/01 10:00 PST for pre-flight. :thumbsup:
